# M5 · Interior Design & Build Studio, Miami

> M5 is an interior design, renovation and construction studio in Miami, Florida (M5 STUDIO MIAMI LLC). One accountable team designs it, builds it and answers for it: interior design and 3D, turnkey condo and villa renovation, fit-out, technical supervision — and our signature Venetian plaster, hand-applied by our own master with our own mineral materials. Construction is executed with licensed & insured Florida contractor partners. Languages: English, Spanish, Ukrainian, Russian.

## What M5 does

- Interior design & 3D: concept, layouts, photoreal visualization, materials and documentation. Turnkey design + renovation projects start around $130K; itemized budget before the contract, change orders signed by the client first, milestone payments, 1-year written warranty.
- Turnkey renovation and fit-out in Miami and Miami-Dade: one contract from demolition to décor, weekly photo updates, Miami-Dade permits, condo-board paperwork (COI, elevator bookings, noise hours) handled by M5. Built with licensed & insured Florida contractor partners.
- Venetian plaster and mineral wall finishes (our signature): Venetian, Marmorino, Travertine, Concrete, Silk, Silk White, Velvet, Velvet Matte, Velvet White, Crystal, Crystal Shine, Exotic, Las Vegas — 13 own mineral materials, 27 hand-applied finishes, any color to order. Walls, ceilings, fireplaces, bathrooms and powder rooms, façades. Plaster projects from $10,000; a real hand-made sample within 48 hours, free site visit, fixed written price.

## Key facts

- Venetian plaster projects start at $10,000; the exact price depends on material, area and substrate and is fixed in writing after a free site visit.
- Timeline: sample in 48 h; an accent wall 2–3 days on site; a full room about a week. A typical renovation takes up to 3 months.
- Mineral plaster is seamless, breathable, washable and repairable — suited to Miami humidity and air conditioning; wet zones are sealed.
- Showroom: Miami Ironside, 7636 NE 4th Ct #111, Miami, FL 33138. Opening November 2026, visits by appointment.
- Service area: Miami, Miami Beach, Brickell, Edgewater, Coral Gables, Sunny Isles Beach, Wynwood; façade plaster work across Florida.
